title: atylosia scarabaeoides var. typica
intro: Atylosia scarabaeoides var. typica, commonly known as the scarab bean or hairy stickpea, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Atylosia scarabaeoides var. typica include anti-diarrheal, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
